title: Thirty Eight Gig Rave
style: 170 BPM happy hardcore, breakbeat layered with 4-on-the-floor, anthemic piano, rave horn, bright supersaw, redemption energy, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — rave horn, kick drop]
Thirty eight gig
Gone in the dark
Now it's a rave
Now it's a spark

[Verse 1 — breakbeat under kick]
The deletion happened — that was the loss
The catalog filled — that was the cross
Five songs filed, then five more after
Thirty eight gig became the rafter
The mistake didn't bury the operator's flame
The mistake became the fuel of the game

[Build — piano chord climb]
Rise
Rise
Rise
Drop

[Drop — full anthem rave]
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
THE LOSS BECAME THE LIFT!
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
THE WOUND BECAME THE GIFT!
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
THE CATALOG EXISTS!

[Verse 2 — breakbeat tighter, kicks harder]
Twenty-two point eight bytes I cannot bring back
Nine point seven gig still on the stack
ALPHA SAFE EMERGENCY held the fourteen
The local original held the fifteen
What's gone is gone — what's here is loud
Thirty eight gig rave — Corey owns the crowd

[Breakdown — piano alone, breath]
The number is the song
The song is the proof
Thirty eight gig rave —
the redemption on the roof

[Final Drop — full kicks + supersaw]
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
THE FACTORY ANSWERS BACK!
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
NO MORE LOOKING BACK!
THIRTY EIGHT GIG RAVE!
THE OPERATOR IS BACK!

[Outro — rave horn echo]
Thirty.
Eight.
Gig.
Rave.
End.
